elements.justification: 'motor vehicle' is admitted as DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'); ru.aggregate is 'membership of a legal aggregate'. The class atom ru.motor_vehicle never replaces an admitted aggregate. The exception's complement, a vehicle that is not self-propelled (a trailer standing on its own), is the class the duty concerns. But the only class carrying such a vehicle is ru.trailer_or_combination, 'vehicle drawn by another, or the combination', and the combination includes its self-propelled towing vehicle. The run's reading therefore lists that class as unresolved under this id, and by the aggregate's contract ('unknown when no included class holds and the user carries an unresolved class') no realistic vehicle is decidedly outside the exception. The span is mapped to its nearest atom with an atom gap (gaps).

'park' applies DEF-NRS-484A-155 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading'; drv.motion.parked denotes 'at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration', a shorter halt 'is not denoted'. Same mapping as the index's 'It shall be unlawful for any person to park'.
'vehicle' is admitted as DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; ru.aggregate is 'membership of a legal aggregate'.

'Street' applies DEF-NRS-484A-265 'the entire width between the boundary lines of every highway inside the territorial limits of a city'. st.highway is 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders'; it is not the roadway alone, and the roadway's exclusion does not apply because the definition takes the entire width. rel.occupies anchors the vehicle's footprint on it. Same mapping as the index's 'upon any street' (LVMC_11_48_050). The city limits are the jurisdiction this city ordinance applies in.

'for a period of time longer than thirty minutes' is one continuous period of parking: a time window of the stated length behind the observation, at every observation of which the vehicle was parked on the street within the hours. The window reads kin.time, 'instant of observation of a scene'. Thirty minutes is declared as 30 min, the unit of a time window.

env.civil_time is 'the local calendar time of the observation: date, weekday, time of day (from the recording's metadata, not from the scene)'. Its measure env_civil_time has unit 1 (section 11), and it reads the time of day as minute_of_day, the count of minutes since midnight. The law states the hours itself, so the stated hours are declared in that field's own unit: 'one a.m.' is minute of day 60 and 'six a.m.' is minute of day 360, both unitless. The minute of day is compared with them directly, with no conversion factor. 'Not a stand-in for: kin.time' does not apply, because the clock of day is read, not the order of observations. Same atom as the index's 'between the hours of seven p.m. and six a.m.;' (LVMC_11_48_050).

applicability: The subject is a vehicle and not a motor vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle does not hold), its footprint overlaps a street (st.highway, rel.occupies), and the civil minute of day (env.civil_time, minute_of_day) is at or after 60 (one a.m.) and before 360 (six a.m.).
obligation: It is not the case that, at every observation of the thirty-minute time window behind the observation, the subject was parked (drv.motion.parked with p.halt_speed_tolerance, p.parking_min_duration) with its footprint on a street and with the civil minute of day at or after 60 (one a.m.) and before 360 (six a.m.).

narrowings.why: 'no person shall park' is read through the vehicle's own standing, whoever controls it. The definition's temporary halt for loading or unloading is read through the halt's duration (min_duration), because the purpose itself is not observed.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A trailer standing uncoupled (a vehicle, not self-propelled, so not a motor vehicle) stands at rest on a street from 01:10 to 01:50 civil time.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: An uncoupled trailer stands at rest on a street from 02:00 to 02:20 civil time and is then towed away.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A passenger car (motor vehicle aggregate) stands at rest on a street from 01:00 to 05:00 civil time.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: An uncoupled trailer stands at rest on a street for forty minutes. The recording carries no civil time, so whether the period lies between one and six a.m. is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: An uncoupled trailer stands at rest on a street from 00:30 to 01:20 civil time and is then towed away. Only twenty minutes of the period lie within the hours.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition source's kinematic channel

param_proposals.name: p.parking_min_duration
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as temporary, as for loading or unloading: a common time limit of a passenger loading zone
param_proposals.source: municipal curbside management practice: passenger loading zone time limits

gaps.proposal: A road-user class atom, or an attribute of ru.trailer_or_combination, that tells a vehicle which is not self-propelled from a combination that includes its towing motor vehicle. Examples of the first are a trailer or semitrailer standing uncoupled from any towing vehicle, or an animal-drawn vehicle. With it the reading could exclude that class under DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled'). It decides which road users the duty concerns. Without it, every vehicle is either a motor vehicle (exception holds, not applicable) or of an unresolved class (exception unknown), so the duty can never be found violated.
nearest: ru.trailer_or_combination: 'vehicle drawn by another, or the combination' — it lumps the non-self-propelled trailer with the combination, which is self-propelled, so the reading leaves it unresolved under DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle
ru.aggregate: 'unknown when no included class holds and the user carries an unresolved class'
ru.motor_vehicle: 'Not a stand-in for: "vehicle" as a legal aggregate'
